# Levi Boulter

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Levi Boulter is characterized by a mean temperament that limits his willingness to spend time on others. He is also notably tightfisted, demonstrating a strong reluctance to part with his money or resources.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)_

## History

Levi Boulter is an unseen presence during a political conflict near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). His farm's fences become a point of contention when local girls attempt to prevent them from being used for patent medicine advertisements. Though [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) initially refuses their request, he ultimately cancels the advertisement deal to protect his reputation after being overheard accepting a bribe.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P48](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0048), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P51](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0051), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P62](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0062), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P64](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0064), +5 more_
